description: This file defines the 'IntegrationModule' entity class, which models a module configuration within a sales management system, including fields like module name, code, regions, configuration details, image, and audit info.

classes.name: IntegrationModule
classes.description: Entity class representing a system integration module, with configuration attributes, audit tracking, and related collections.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the integration module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the integration module.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the module.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the name of the module.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with the module.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the module.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the regions string.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the regions string.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration details as a string.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration details.

methods.name: getRegionsSet
methods.description: Returns the set of regions.

methods.name: setRegionsSet
methods.description: Sets the regions set.

methods.name: getModuleConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the map of module configurations by environment.

methods.name: setModuleConfigs
methods.description: Sets the map of module configurations.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image associated with the module.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with the module.

methods.name: isCustomModule
methods.description: Checks if this is a custom module.

methods.name: setCustomModule
methods.description: Sets whether this is a custom module.

methods.name: getConfigDetails
methods.description: Retrieves configuration details in string form.

methods.name: setConfigDetails
methods.description: Sets configuration details.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the module.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the module.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section for tracking changes.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section.
